verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer site lists a CLI next to REST and MCP as a first-party access surface, so the product appears to ship its own CLI. That is the only evidence: a single three-word mention with no detail on what the CLI does or how agents use it. Missing for 10: CLI documentation (installation, commands, auth), evidence of agent-friendly behaviour such as structured output or non-interactive use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
